Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 20
Reason for Mistake: The agent prematurely treated a Q3 2021 market report (from SFHIGHRISES) noting the “highest 2BD sale” (Radiance 606 at $2.95M) as the overall highest Mission Bay high-rise sale for all of 2021. This conflated a subset metric (2-bedroom, partial-year scope) with the full-year, all-unit-type maximum and was not cross-verified with other reliable sources or checked for “high-rise” classification, leading to an unsupported final answer.
